rankingHints.note: Factual inputs only — the TL ranks. Derived ordering considerations, not decisions:
rankingHints.enablementStructure: L12 (family-specific drivers) is the measurement enabler for L05/L07/L13 and exposes the real friction/veto distribution the amended-2 baseline will show; the TL may want to sequence L12 early regardless of its 0 direct points
rankingHints.vetoCliffAxis: L10 (authority) and L14 (privacy) dominate any weighted-points view the moment the amended-2 baseline shows vetoes — a single vetoed persona scores 0
rankingHints.lawRiskAxis: L02, L01, L12, L13, L06 carry HIGH no-fabrication/gui-only risk — their measurement protocols must include evidence-integrity audits (see RANKING-EXPERIMENT-DESIGN.md anti-gaming)
excludedFromRanking: persona-journey attribution repair (W3-012, measurement not product)
